_note: v2.9 A02, owner decision 2026-10-25 (v2.8 69 K13 fold), model lane: a real streaming reply the player stops with ST's stop control (#mes_stop: stopGeneration -> onStopStreaming, isFinished true, isStopped false, aborted) is held. Held: no boundary commits on it and a real manual read's window ends before it; the manual read commits its own boundary by design (extractionCoordinator runNow ends in commitBoundary), and that boundary ends right before the held reply (readableEndBefore). Cadence reads are kept out with cadence 1000 (0 is normalised to the default 3) after the reads queued by the setup finish. Released: the next player send (/send compact, which emits MESSAGE_SENT like the send button) commits it as a reply before the player's line, with no reply generated. Swipe: a second stopped reply, then a real new swipe of it: the hold is dropped, the finished swipe commits once on its own, and a later send commits nothing more on it. Needs streaming (switched on in memory for a Text Completion lane, restored in cleanup) and a reply long enough to stop mid-stream. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <model lane> -- scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v29-a02-stopped-reply.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

requires.why: a real streaming generation has to be stopped mid-stream; the manual read is a real memory-model pass

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); const script = await import('/script.js'); const textgen = await import('/scripts/textgen-settings.js'); globalThis.__a02Stream = { api: ctx.mainApi, was: textgen.textgenerationwebui_settings.streaming }; if (!script.isStreamingEnabled() && ctx.mainApi === 'textgenerationwebui') textgen.textgenerationwebui_settings.streaming = true; if (!script.isStreamingEnabled()) throw new Error('streaming is off for main API ' + ctx.mainApi + ': switch Streaming on in the lane connection preset, a stop mid-stream is the whole check'); return { api: ctx.mainApi, streaming: true, switchedOn: globalThis.__a02Stream.was === false };

import_story.title: SO-V29-A02 Stopped reply
import_story.description: Synthetic A02 fixture: a gatekeeper who answers at length, so a reply can be stopped mid-stream.

qualities.rubric: Has the old gate been opened?

checkpoints.name: The old gate
checkpoints.objective: Arin tells the long history of the old gate, in rich detail, several paragraphs at a time.

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The old gate looms over the road. Arin, its keeper, sits on a stone bench beside it.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 1000, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().extraction.cadence !== 1000) throw new Error('cadence did not land: ' + rt.getGlobalSettings().extraction.cadence); const script = await import('/script.js'); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(150); } }; const ctx = () => SillyTavern.getContext(); const visible = (el) => Boolean(el) && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none'; const generating = () => visible(document.querySelector('#mes_stop')) || !visible(document.querySelector('#send_but')); const idle = async (ms) => { let since = 0; await until(() => { if (generating()) { since = 0; return false; } since = since || Date.now(); return Date.now() - since > 1500; }, ms, 'ST to go idle'); }; const log = () => rt.getBoundaryLog(); const at = (id) => log().filter((entry) => entry.context?.lastMessageId === id).length; const audits = () => rt.getExtractionAudits() ?? []; const stopMidStream = async (label) => { if (generating()) throw new Error(label + ': ST is already generating'); const before = ctx().chat.length; void ctx().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/trigger await=false "Arin"'); const sp = await until(() => { const s = script.streamingProcessor; return s && s.messageId >= before ? s : null; }, 120000, label + ': the streamed reply to start'); const id = sp.messageId; await until(() => { if (sp.isFinished) throw new Error(label + ': vacuous, the reply finished (' + String(ctx().chat[id]?.mes ?? '').length + ' chars) before it could be stopped'); return String(ctx().chat[id]?.mes ?? '').trim().length >= 40; }, 300000, label + ': 40 visible characters of the reply'); const button = document.querySelector('#mes_stop'); if (!visible(button)) throw new Error(label + ': the stop control is not shown mid-stream'); button.click(); await idle(60000); const row = ctx().chat[id]; if (!row || row.is_user || String(row.name) !== 'Arin') throw new Error(label + ': the stopped row is not Arin reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ id, name: row?.name })); if (!String(row.mes ?? '').trim()) throw new Error(label + ': the stopped reply is empty'); if (ctx().chat.length - 1 !== id) throw new Error(label + ': a message landed after the stopped reply'); return { id, chars: String(row.mes).length, text: String(row.mes), userStopped: sp.isFinished === true && sp.isStopped !== true && sp.abortController?.signal?.aborted === true }; }; const readsIdle = (ms) => until(() => { const s = rt.getSnapshot().extraction?.scheduler; return s && s.queueDepth === 0 && !s.inFlight; }, ms, 'queued and running reads to finish'); globalThis.__a02 = { pause, until, idle, log, at, audits, stopMidStream, generating, readsIdle }; await idle(30000); await readsIdle(300000); return { audits: audits().length,  boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, lastMessageId: rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId, chat: ctx().chat.length };

steps.send: Arin, tell me the whole history of this gate, from the first stone to today. Leave nothing out.

steps.eval: const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await a.pause(1500); await a.readsIdle(300000); const before = { boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, log: a.log().length, audits: a.audits().length }; const stop = await a.stopMidStream('first stop'); if (!stop.userStopped) throw new Error('ST did not record a user stop on the stream: ' + JSON.stringify(stop)); await a.pause(3000); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.boundary !== before.boundary || a.log().length !== before.log) throw new Error('the stopped reply committed a boundary: ' + JSON.stringify({ before, boundary: state.boundary, log: a.log().length })); if (a.at(stop.id) !== 0 || state.lastMessageId >= stop.id) throw new Error('the engine reached the stopped reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, held: stop.id })); if (a.audits().length !== before.audits) throw new Error('a read ran on the stopped reply'); globalThis.__a02.first = { ...stop, boundary: before.boundary, log: before.log }; return { held: stop.id, chars: stop.chars, boundary: state.boundary };

const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const held = a.first.id; const count = a.audits().length; await rt.runExtractionNow(undefined, 'manual'); await a.until(() => a.audits().length > count, 300000, 'the real manual read to record an audit'); const audit = a.audits()[a.audits().length - 1]; if (String(audit.rawResponse ?? '').includes('debugResponse')) throw new Error('the read was mocked'); if (!audit.window || audit.window.to >= held) throw new Error('the read window covers the held reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ window: audit.window, held })); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const added = a.log().slice(a.first.log).map((entry) => entry.context?.lastMessageId); if (state.boundary !== a.first.boundary + 1 || added.length !== 1 || added[0] !== held - 1) throw new Error('the manual read must commit exactly one boundary, ending right before the held reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: a.first.boundary, boundary: state.boundary, added, held })); if (a.at(held) !== 0 || state.lastMessageId >= held) throw new Error('the manual read committed the held reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, held })); globalThis.__a02.read = { boundary: state.boundary, log: a.log().length }; return { window: audit.window, held, reason: audit.reason, committedAt: added[0] };

const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const held = a.first.id; const player = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (!ctx.chat[player]?.is_user || player !== held + 1) throw new Error('the player line is not right after the held reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ player, held })); await a.until(() => a.at(held) === 1, 15000, 'the send to commit the held reply'); await a.pause(1500); const entries = a.log().slice(a.read.log); const ids = entries.map((entry) => entry.context?.lastMessageId); if (ids.length !== 1 || ids[0] !== held) throw new Error('expected exactly one commit, on the held reply, before the player line: ' + JSON.stringify(ids)); if (String(ctx.chat[held].mes) !== a.first.text) throw new Error('the released reply text changed'); if (a.generating()) throw new Error('the compact send started a generation'); globalThis.__a02.released = { boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, log: a.log().length }; return { committed: ids, boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, player };

const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const stop = await a.stopMidStream('second stop'); await a.pause(3000); if (rt.getEngineState().boundary !== a.released.boundary || a.log().length !== a.released.log || a.at(stop.id) !== 0) throw new Error('the second stopped reply committed: ' + JSON.stringify({ boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, released: a.released, at: a.at(stop.id) })); globalThis.__a02.second = stop; return { held: stop.id, chars: stop.chars };

const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = a.second.id; await a.idle(120000); const row = ctx.chat[id]; if (ctx.chat.length - 1 !== id || (row.swipes?.length ?? 1) < 2 || !row.swipe_id) throw new Error('no new swipe on the held reply: ' + JSON.stringify({ length: ctx.chat.length, id, swipes: row.swipes?.length, swipe_id: row.swipe_id })); if (String(row.mes) === a.second.text || !String(row.mes).trim()) throw new Error('the swipe did not replace the stopped text'); await a.until(() => a.at(id) === 1, 30000, 'the finished swipe to commit on its own'); await a.pause(1500); if (a.at(id) !== 1) throw new Error('the swiped reply committed more than once: ' + a.at(id)); globalThis.__a02.swiped = { boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, log: a.log().length }; return { id, swipe: row.swipe_id, boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary };

const a = globalThis.__a02; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await a.pause(3000); if (rt.getEngineState().boundary !== a.swiped.boundary || a.log().length !== a.swiped.log || a.at(a.second.id) !== 1) throw new Error('the send committed the dropped hold again: ' + JSON.stringify({ boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, swiped: a.swiped, at: a.at(a.second.id) })); return { boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary, commitsOnSwiped: a.at(a.second.id) };

const stream = globalThis.__a02Stream; if (stream && stream.api === 'textgenerationwebui' && stream.was === false) { const textgen = await import('/scripts/textgen-settings.js'); textgen.textgenerationwebui_settings.streaming = false; } delete globalThis.__a02Stream; delete globalThis.__a02; return { restored: Boolean(stream) };
